parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

403.description: FlowLINE is not enabled for this user, or the token was rejected

post.summary: Open (or reopen) a support window for a device

deviceId.description: Device id shown by the support module

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: Window opened (`window` false when the device already has an account)

403.description: FlowLINE is not enabled for this user, the token was rejected, or the token lacks the invitations permission

409.description: Another account already has an active window on this device

429.description: FlowLINE API rate limit reached (too many active windows)

502.description: FlowLINE API unreachable or invalid response

delete.summary: End the support window of a device

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device id shown by the support module

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

200.description: Window ended (`quit` is sent to the module at its next heartbeat)

403.description: FlowLINE is not enabled for this user, the token was rejected, or the token lacks the invitations permission

404.description: No FlowLINE account linked, or no active window for this device

502.description: FlowLINE API unreachable or invalid response

tags.name: web_client
tags.description: Page « assistance navigateur » : sert le client web FlowLINE (bundle construit dans `webclient/`) avec la configuration WS injectée. Sécurité : le jeton `flapi_` n'est jamais transmis au navigateur — la page ne parle qu'aux endpoints WebSocket publics, et l'autorisation (fenêtre support) est ouverte côté serveur par la console (API v1). La CSP est restreinte à `self` + les origines WS configurées. L'id cible (`?target=…`) est lu par le client web lui-même (jamais injecté dans le HTML). Le bundle est servi par ce contrôleur (page + assets) : les fichiers statiques d'une app ne sont pas accessibles via `/apps/<id>/…` quand l'app est installée dans `custom_apps/` (instance de dev) — les routes, elles, fonctionnent partout.
